name: Motoba Takeshi
source: Taihei's coworker and Kirie's older brother. He likes to slack off at work. He and Taihei have been friends since high school, but he was not as studious as Taihei. He tries to interact with his own little sister often, but the latter gets annoyed from him.
translation: Taihei's coworker and Kirie's older brother. He likes to slack off at work. He and Taihei have been friends since high school, but he was not as studious as Taihei. He tries to interact with his own little sister often, but the latter gets annoyed from him.
